text:
emma: beginning staged unpin of runtime v2.14 -> v3.0 in us-west-2 during 02:00-04:00 change window. starting canary at 5% :eyes:
deploybot: rollout started for runtime v3.0 to us-west-2 (canary=5%) — job #r-2026-91. Logs will stream to /deploys/r-2026-91
raj: seeing spike in error-rate for model gptx2 on canary nodes, +2.1x  — grabbed a few traces, looks like negotiation failures
oliver: putting the log snippet here:
```
ClientNegotiationError: incompatible runtime API version: server=v3.0 client=1.4
  at negotiate (runtime/handshake.go:87)
  at serve (runtime/serve.go:432)
```
kai: 1.4 SDK clients were supposed to be compatible via runtime shim. did we miss the shim build in this runtime? :rotating_light:
emma: pausing rollout. deploybot please PAUSE job #r-2026-91. hold canary and stop further regions.
deploybot: rollout paused by @emma for job #r-2026-91 — canary traffic frozen at 5%
raj: confirmed errors reproduce locally when client=1.4 against runtime v3.0. compatibility layer doesn't mount — looks like an image packaging diff (missing /opt/runtime/shims/sdk-compat)
oliver: quick diff: the runtime Dockerfile in v3.0 removed the compat layer to trim size. it was an intentional change but not flagged in the compat matrix.
kai: we have two paths: (A) re-add shim to runtime image and re-deploy v3.0, (B) rollback to v2.14 across canaries and resume a smaller change window.
emma: prefer rollback for safety. we need minimal blast radius. prepare rollback runbook and update release_notes.md to mark v3.0 staged-unpin paused. add incident note.
raj: rollback command (tested in staging):
```
deploybot rollback --job r-2026-91 --to-image redwood/runtime:v2.14 --regions us-west-2 --confirm
```
kai: i'll run the rollback and watch canary dashboards. grabbing DMs with @devops for quota windows.
deploybot: scheduled rollback initiated by @kai for job #r-2026-91. estimated completion 3min per node group.
sre_bot: created alert: CANARY_NEGOTIATION_FAIL — threshold=0.5% errors over baseline. paging set to oncall SRE.
emma: I'll open a short status page entry: "Staged unpin to runtime v3.0 paused due to SDK compatibility issue; rollback in progress." Will post link here when live. :thumbsup:
oliver: once rollback completes we should add compatibility test in PR gating: run sdk-compat matrix in image build pipeline and fail if shim missing.
raj: agreed. also add a postmortem note in release docs and tag teams: eng-runtime, devex, sdk.
kai: rollback completed on canary groups. monitoring shows errors falling back to baseline. resuming normal ops but keeping v3.0 blocked until fix.
deploybot: job #r-2026-91 rollback completed. runtime image set to v2.14 for all canary targets.
emma: good work. next steps: oliver to prepare shim re-add PR, devex to run cross-version e2e, release_notes to be updated with the pause and rollback. i'll coordinate a new change window once compatibility validated.
sre_bot: created post-check alert ticket and a follow-up dashboard panel for runtime-api-versions.
raj: thanks all. tagging @dev-customers-notify to draft a brief note if we see customer-facing errors, but so far looks contained.
kai: ack. will keep watch for 30m then close thread. :white_check_mark:
